question_text: A municipal office's budget of P800,000 was reduced by 15% due to austerity measures. What is the new budget?

hint_ladder.title: Ang Natitirang Porsyento
hint_ladder.text: Kapag binawasan ng 15%, 85% na lang ang matitira. Sa halip na i-compute ang bawas, isipin mo na lang 'yung pagkuha ng natitira — parang sale!

hint_ladder.title: Simple Formula
hint_ladder.text: I-multiply ang original budget sa (1 minus porsyento ng bawas). Dito: 800,000 × (1 - 0.15) = 800,000 × 0.85. Diretso na, isang step lang.

hint_ladder.title: Alamin ang Bawas
hint_ladder.text: Kung gusto mo munang alamin ang exact na halaga ng 15%: 0.15 × 800,000 = P120,000. Iyan ang binawas.

hint_ladder.title: Ibawas para sa Sagot
hint_ladder.text: P800,000 minus P120,000 = P680,000. 'Yan ang bagong budget!

A.text: You might have chosen A because you confused a 15% reduction with a 20% reduction, a 5 percentage point error, yielding 800k×0.80=P640k.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you miscalculated 15% of 800k as 140k instead of 120k, a 2.5 percentage point overestimate, giving 660k.

C.text: Correct. 15% of 800k is 120k; subtract to get 680k, or simply multiply 800k by 0.85 because you keep 85% after a 15% cut.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you thought the cut was only 10%, a 5 percentage point underestimate, leaving 720k.

next_time_rule: Next time: multiply original sa (100% – bawas). Isipin mong 'keep the change' — i-multiply sa natirang porsyento para diretso ang sagot.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mong budget ng Barangay Health Center 'yan. P800,000 na binawasan ng 15% dahil sa austerity. Compute muna natin ang 15%: 0.15 × 800,000 = P120,000. 'Yan ang nawala. So ang bago mong budget: P800,000 minus P120,000 = P680,000. Tama!

Mental shortcut: imultiply mo na lang sa natitirang porsyento. 100% minus 15% = 85%. Kaya 800,000 × 0.85 = 680,000. Ganun lang!
